blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the ₱312.1 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the ₱15 million Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Wednesday, Oct. 28, 2026. The Grand Lotto 6/55 draw produced the winning combination 36-21-16-26-49-13, with a jackpot prize of ₱312.1 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The Mega Lotto 6/45 draw yielded the winning combination 19-40-37-01-14-29, with a jackpot prize of ₱15 million. No bettor won the top prize.
